episode_row: Healthchecks ping URL hardcoded in the public repo's cron script; check rotated

commits.subject: harden: cron-setup requires HEALTHCHECKS_PING_URL from env (no hardcoded ping URL)
commits.body:
The hardcoded hc-ping.com fallback was leaked in this public repo. Make the var
required (errors loudly if unset) so a real ping URL is never baked into the
script again; document that .env must be sourced before running it. Leaked
check has been rotated to a new UUID and the box cut over.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
